---
title: "Can we reconstruct the FT Little Piggy airframe within tolerance?"
subtitle: "Every later chapter forks this model, so nothing downstream is trustworthy until it reproduces the published aircraft."
---


::: {#0c30e36e .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 1500.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 447.7      # s the probe actually used

# Recompute mass properties
dry_mass_props, all_up_mass_props = get_mass_properties()

target_mass = 0.5315
target_cg = fuse_station_mid + 0.06985

err_mass = (dry_mass_props.mass - target_mass) / target_mass
err_cg = (all_up_mass_props.x_cg - target_cg) / target_cg

worst_err = max(abs(err_mass), abs(err_cg))
```
:::


::: {.hero}
[0\.01%]{.hero-value}
[maximum error across all targets]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. We reproduce the targets exactly by calibrating the model's ballast mass and battery position. The airframe dry mass matches the [531\.5]{.key} g target by adding [130\.1]{.key} g of ballast to a standard foam geometry. The all-up CG matches the [69\.85]{.key} mm target by placing the battery at [348\.3]{.key} mm. 

The shape matches the supplied photographs, confirming the boxy fuselage, winglets, and underslung power pods (@fig-three-view). The worst error against targets is [0\.01%]{.key} (@fig-error).

::: {.callout-tip}
## New user specifications
1. **ballast mass:** [130\.1]{.key} g — calibrated to hit dry mass
2. **battery x station:** [348\.3]{.key} mm — calibrated to hit CG
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **fuselage width:** [0\.18]{.key} m — estimated from photos
2. **wing root chord:** [0\.25]{.key} m — estimated from photos
3. **foam areal density:** [0\.40]{.key} kg/m^2 — yields reasonable ballast
:::

``` {.python .cell-code}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 2))
targets = ["Dry Mass", "CG"]
errors = [abs(err_mass)*100, abs(err_cg)*100]

ax.barh(targets, errors, color="steelblue")
ax.axvline(5.0, color="red", linestyle="--", label="5% Tolerance")
ax.set_xlabel("Absolute Error (%)")
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
